data.long_meaning: The name Nelly is derived from the Greek name Nelos, which means 'shining light' or 'miracle of the sun'. In Greek mythology, Nelos was a hero and the name was also borne by a famous wrestler. In Christianity, the name Nelly is believed to symbolize the light of faith and hope in God. The name Nelly carries the meaning “Light, shining one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Nelly usually hope their child will grow to embody light, shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
